assignments.source_kind: Original CC0 parametric reconstruction from manufacturer CT6EP drawing
assignments.classification: Detailed datasheet-derived CT6EP family model with nominal untrimmed leads
limitations: Manufacturer CT6EP drawing supplies7x7x5.8mm envelope,0.6x2.6x1.6mm crossslot,0.45mm leads,5x2.5mm lead grid and7+/-2mm untrimmed length. Current Nidec/Copal family is not proven identical to original Vishay-supplied historical stock.
Housing radii, seam/lug positions, label-panel relief and rotor/tooth dimensions are interpreted from the unsized outline; not factory CAD. Resistance and production date are not invented.

The canonical origin and native assignment transform are unchanged. Body seated atZ0 is an installed-height assumption. Leads are manufacturer nominal untrimmed length; actual soldered trim length is unknown.

Nominal lead grid differs from original board5.08x2.54 by0.04mm peraxis. Nominal drill1.0mm minus lead0.45mm permits this nominal centre mismatch; tolerance and real formed-lead seating are not qualified.
No part body was reduced or moved to fit the case. This visual model is not physical assembly or fabrication qualification.
